THE GENUINELY NEW PIECE, distinct from every sibling: this card's own '...has \"Whenever this creature attacks, you gain 1 life,\"...' clause GRANTS A WHOLE NEW TRIGGERED ABILITY (its own trigger condition PLUS its own effect) to the equipped creature — checked the full real `Effect` union in card.ts and confirmed no vocabulary or pipeline exists anywhere in this model for granting a NEW triggered ability to another permanent (closest is `grantKeywordTarget`/`grantKeywordAll`, which only ever grant a KEYWORD, never a fresh ability with its own condition+effect) — a genuinely different, third gap class from pump/grantType's own 'static bonus/type broadcast' gap, not the same thing wearing a different label. Also checked the pool for any existing 'grants an ability' vocabulary before treating this as new: none exists (`grep`'d synergy.ts/card.ts/ENGINE_GAPS.md for grantAbility/'grant ability'/'grant.*trigger' — nothing). Separately checked several pre-migration sibling Equipment cards with an identical 'granted triggered ability' shape (buster-sword's drawCard-on-damage, genji-glove's double-strike+untap+extra-combat, thief-s-knife's draw-on-damage, ninja-s-blades' discard/loseLife, astrologian-s-planisphere's putCounter-on-cast/draw) for a possible precedent: all of them model the granted ability's real-world CONSEQUENCE (when a real Effect kind exists for it) as if it were the Equipment's OWN named trigger (`onEquippedDealsDamage`/`onEquippedAttacksFirstCombat`/etc, a documented, already-established simplification — 'the real source is whichever creature is equipped, not this permanent') — but critically, NONE of them have added a real Fact for that consequence yet (all still pre-migration, empty/legacy `source: []` or old id-shape), so there's no existing v2-Fact precedent to follow for whether the CONSEQUENCE gets modeled as real+executable or stays inert. Chose NOT to wire a new `onEquippedAttacks` trigger + `gainLife` effect into definition.ts even though the mechanism would be trivial to reuse (a real, established simplification) and the consequence (life gain) has real, already-promoted vocabulary (`event:'lifegain'`) — per this task's own explicit instruction not to fabricate execution for this specific gap, and because fabricating real trace evidence for a granted ability this model can't actually grant would misrepresent an unmodeled mechanism as a real, working one. Modeled the fact itself as `{event:'lifegain', controller:'you', value:1}` (real, directly-known magnitude — 'gain 1 life' is a fixed amount, not a sentinel — reusing already-established `lifegain` vocabulary rather than inventing a new event name, since the real-world CONSEQUENCE this clause describes is already exactly what `lifegain` means), exempted via a new, card-name-scoped `isWhiteMagesStaffGrantedAbilityFact` in verify-synergy.mjs (own doc comment there explains the gap-class distinction from the pump/grantType exemptions in full, not repeated here).

No 'equip' event fact added anywhere (the actual attach action, both via Job select's auto-attach and the Equip {3} activated ability, stays covered by the existing parked fn:'equip' — PARKED_ACTION_FNS — same treatment every other Equipment in the pool already gets).
